subcompetencies.name: Procedures Performed in the Pre-Hospital Environment

level_1: Knows indications, contraindications, risks, and benefits, anatomic landmarks, equipment, procedural technique, and potential complications of common pre-hospital procedures
Evaluates the environment and situation in the decision to perform a procedure
level_2: Recognizes that the pre- hospital environment affects procedures
Performs indicated procedures on patients, including those with challenging features (e.g., poorly identifiable landmarks, at extremes of age, or with co- morbid conditions)
level_3: Performs the indicated common procedure on patients with moderate urgency who have identifiable landmarks and a low-moderate risk for complications
Modifies the procedure depending on the environment and situation
level_4: Discusses the effects of the pre-hospital environment on performing procedures
Incorporates evidence- based medicine to improve procedures and develop novel techniques used in different environments
level_5: Performs the indicated procedure, takes steps to avoid potential complications, and recognizes the outcome and/or complications resulting from the procedure
